Imagine… the Venom symbiote takes over Superman.
What would happen?
You are in Metropolis.
Superman flies overhead.
But his blue suit… starts turning black.
Then.
The symbiote makes every power of its host stronger.
And Superman is already faster than a speeding bullet.
Now add a creature that is always hungry.
He doesn't save the city anymore.
He hunts it.
Even kryptonite might not reach him.
But the symbiote has two old weaknesses.
Sound… and fire.
And Superman carries both.
Heat vision is fire.
One clap of his hands is a sonic boom.
It chose the one body it can't survive.
Superman first flew in 1938.
A copy of that comic sold for six million dollars.
So remember.
Power is never the danger… it's who controls it.
